entry.summary:
RAG brings books to the exam. Knowledge Engineering teaches Agents to study. Memory architecture matters more than retrieval tuning.
Everyone says the Agent era is about better prompts, bigger context windows, and smarter retrieval. That is true — but it is not the bottleneck anymore. The bottleneck is memory architecture. Most teams still treat knowledge like a temporary input: retrieve chunks, answer the question, discard the trace. That works for demos. It fails in long-running systems. The same questions get re-solved. The same contradictions get rediscovered. The same context gets paid for, again and again. entry.title: Tokenized Equities 2026: Inside the Future of Global Equity Markets
entry.summary: Tokenized equities are stocks and ETFs issued on blockchains. Here's what they are, how they work, and what's still broken.
